laws.rule: Visitors must follow the law and public order, respect local culture, customs and religion, follow traffic, health and safety rules, care for historic sites, relics and tourism facilities, and not interfere with business when they are in a dispute (article 10). Outbound tour members may not overstay abroad or leave their group without permission.
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
laws.heading: 江西省旅游条例 (Jiangxi Province Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: Lushan: banned acts include digging or quarrying, hammering nails into or carving or scribbling on features, littering, damaging facilities, and setting off fireworks, dropping cigarette ends or lighting fires, incense or crackers outside designated places (article 14). In Guling, breaking branches, picking flowers and keeping poultry or livestock are banned (article 15). Pitching tents or sky shelters is managed by the scenic-area authority. Entering areas not developed or not opened, and exploring or rock climbing there, is banned (article 31).
laws.penalty_signal: Breaking branches or picking flowers in Guling: CNY 50 (about A$10.67); livestock kept after being told to stop: seized and CNY 50 to 500 (about A$10.67 to A$107) (article 34). Entering unopened areas or exploring after being told to stop: warning or CNY 500 to 2,000 (about A$107 to A$427); rescue costs are paid by the organiser and the person rescued (article 35). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 江西省庐山风景名胜区管理条例 (Jiangxi Province Lushan Scenic Area Administration Regulation)

laws.rule: Sanqing Mountain: visitors and residents may not damage scenery, water, plants, wildlife or facilities (article 13). The scenic area is split into protection zones with banned acts at each level, including carving, scribbling, climbing and nailing, dumping waste and cooking or lighting fires outside designated places (articles 17 to 20). Visitors may not enter the special protection zone.
laws.penalty_signal: Carving, scribbling, climbing, nailing, dumping waste, or a visitor entering the special protection zone: CNY 50 (about A$10.67) (article 39). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
